ledger.claim: Should the deviation be sustained notwithstanding the impairment, POL-RD-02 runs because fare_breakdown.fare_model is METERED: recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 11.0 + 0.28 x 22.0) x 1.1, the surge_multiplier read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + 0.80 platform fee = 20.831; refund = charged_total 26.60 - 20.831 = 5.769, rounded UP to SGD 5.80, which is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and is the precise amount the rider contests.

The trace the rider relies on is impaired on the very segment he disputes. EV-GPS-09115 carries a 160-second gap between consecutive fixes (20:03:10 to 20:05:50, with a 1.35 km straight-line jump across it), which is well over the 90-second threshold in POL-RD-07 limb (a), and the admissibility pre-pass tags the artifact IMPAIRED with issue code GPS_GAP at weight 0.6. I disclose that impairment and those issue codes: the trace is impaired for policy purposes, so a deviation cannot be established on it alone.

Under POL-RD-07 limb (i) the distance across that impaired stretch is measured as the straight line between the bounding fixes, which is the reading most favourable to the driver, and on this record that is 1.35 km. The rider's own claim places the departure from the booked route at the gap itself, so the stretch the policy deems unreliable is exactly the stretch from which his 4 km excess is drawn. (Evidence cited is impaired: EV-GPS-09115, issue GPS_GAP, weight 0.6.)

The excess has no independent corroboration of the kind POL-RD-07 limb (ii) demands. The pool contains only three distance figures — gps_trace.trace_distance_km 15.0, trip_record.actual_distance_km 15.0 and fare_breakdown.distance_charged_km 15.0 — and they are one and the same measurement: POL-RD-01 describes actual_distance_km as a rounded convenience copy of the trace measurement, and POL-RD-07 limb (ii) expressly excludes a billed distance that is a copy of the trace figure. Not one of them is independent. (EV-GPS-09115 is impaired: GPS_GAP, weight 0.6.)

Nor does any other limb (ii) source exist. The fare_breakdown's erp_gantries array is empty, so no charged gantry places the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route does not use. The chat log records only the rider reporting that the route display jumped and the driver answering that his own navigation display refreshed — a report of a display glitch, not an admission of a detour. The driver's counterparty statement denies any extra stop or detour request and candidly states that he cannot account for the telemetry gap. That is a denial, not the admission the clause requires.

Because the impaired trace stands uncorroborated, POL-RD-07 limb (iii) directs that the claim is not sustained on the present record and that the outcome is ESCALATE rather than NO_ACTION — the absence of proof here is a data failure, not a finding for the driver. The rider's asserted 4 km excess therefore cannot be converted into a refund on this evidence. (EV-GPS-09115 is impaired: GPS_GAP, weight 0.6.)

Escalation is in any event mandatory under POL-RD-10 limb (3): the gps_trace is impaired under POL-RD-07 limbs (a) to (c) and no corroborating artifact of the kind POL-RD-07 limb (ii) names exists in the pool. Independently, the fact that decides this case — the impairment itself — is carried only by an artifact at weight 0.6, so confidence is capped at 0.6 under POL-GEN-02 and sits below the platform-wide 0.70 floor that POL-RD-10 limb (1) applies. (EV-GPS-09115 is impaired: GPS_GAP, weight 0.6.)

The rider carries the initial burden under POL-RD-08 and has not discharged it. The trip identifiers do match across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown, so element (a) is satisfied; but element (b) requires an excess measured from an unimpaired gps_trace or, where the trace is impaired under POL-RD-07 limbs (a) to (c), from an independent source named in POL-RD-07 limb (ii). The trace is impaired and no independent source exists, so the burden never shifts to the driver and the prima facie case fails. (EV-GPS-09115 is impaired: GPS_GAP, weight 0.6.)

Even taken at face value, this is not a MATERIAL deviation. The 36.4% and 4.0 km excess clears POL-RD-01's establishment gate but falls short of the 50% and 8.0 km materiality tests, so the POL-RD-06 driver_profile check is not engaged on materiality. No pattern exists in any event: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 across 610 completed trips in the trailing 90 days, so neither the limb (b) uplift nor the limb (c) conduct referral is available against this driver.

The disposition the record supports is ESCALATE, and on this rider-filed dispute that outcome preserves the driver's position: escalation holds the disputed amount rather than collecting or refunding it, and does not restore or issue any refund to the rider. Nothing is returned to the rider and the fare stands pending human review. (EV-GPS-09115 is impaired: GPS_GAP, weight 0.6.)

ruling.confidence_note: capped at 0.6 by EV-GPS-09115, the sole carrier of the deciding impairment fact
ruling.explanation:
This case goes to a human reviewer, and the disputed SGD 5.80 is held rather than collected or refunded. Here is why.

WHAT THE RECORD SHOWS. The booked (optimal) route is 11.0 km (EV-TRIP-09115, weight 1.0). The trip record and the GPS trace both report 15.0 km, an excess of about 4.0 km (36%) — which by itself would clear the route-deviation gate in POL-RD-01.

BUT THE GPS TRACE IS IMPAIRED. EV-GPS-09115 carries a 160-second gap between consecutive fixes (20:03:10 to 20:05:50, with a 1.35 km straight-line jump across it). That is well over the 90-second limit in POL-RD-07 limb (a). The admissibility pre-pass tags the artifact IMPAIRED with issue code GPS_GAP and down-weights it to 0.6, and I disclose that impairment, that weight and that issue code here, as POL-GEN-02(3) requires. The gap falls exactly where the rider says the vehicle left the booked route.

CORROBORATION IS REQUIRED AND IS ABSENT. Because the trace is impaired under POL-RD-07, that clause forbids establishing the deviation on the trace alone; an independent source is required from the list in limb (ii). None exists. (1) The chat log (EV-CHAT-09115, weight 1.0) records only the rider saying the route display jumped and the driver answering that his own navigation display also refreshed — a display glitch, not an admission of a detour. (2) The fare breakdown's erp_gantries array is empty (EV-FARE-09115, weight 1.0), so no charged gantry places the vehicle off the optimal corridor. (3) The driver's counterparty statement denies any extra stop or detour request and candidly says he cannot account for the telemetry gap — a denial, not an admission of the route. (4) trip_record.actual_distance_km (15.0 km) is, per POL-RD-01, a rounded convenience copy of the same trace measurement, so it is not independent; the trace, trip-record and billed distances are one measurement, not three.

THE CONSEQUENCE. With the trace impaired under POL-RD-07(a)–(c) and no corroborating artifact of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names, POL-RD-07(iii) and POL-RD-10(3) require ESCALATE, not a ruling for either side. The absence of proof here is a data failure, not a finding for the driver, so the outcome is not NO_ACTION. The fact that decides the case — the impairment itself — is carried only by EV-GPS-09115 at weight 0.6, so under POL-GEN-02(2) confidence is capped at 0.6, which is also below the 0.70 platform floor that POL-RD-10(1) applies. Escalation is terminal.

CLAIMS ON BOTH SIDES. The rider's threshold claim under POL-RD-01 (4.0 km / 36.36%) is correct on the face of the figures, but the excess cannot be established on an impaired and uncorroborated trace, so it does not carry. The rider's POL-RD-02 recomputation of SGD 5.80 is therefore not reached: it presupposes a deviation established under POL-RD-01. The rider's point that the driver cannot invoke an exculpatory clause is accepted on this record — the only traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-09115-01, is MISSING at weight 0.0 (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT), so POL-RD-03 cannot run; both amendment timestamp fields are null, so POL-RD-05 cannot run; both chat messages carry waypoint_hint null and name no road, so POL-RD-04's corroboration test cannot be run and that clause is unavailable; and vehicle_type RYDE_X is not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. The driver's burden-shifting point under POL-RD-08 is accepted. The driver's point that this is not a MATERIAL deviation, and that no POL-RD-06 pattern exists, is also accepted: 36% and 4.0 km fall short of the 50% and 8.0 km materiality tests, and driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 across 610 completed trips in the trailing 90 days, so neither the POL-RD-06(b) uplift nor the POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral is available, and no referral is issued. No other clause produces a referral: there is no phantom gantry and no airport surcharge line, so POL-RD-09(4) is not engaged.

WHAT WOULD RESOLVE IT. A human reviewer should obtain a corroborating record for the segment inside the 160-second gap — a restored trace segment or an independent telemetry source showing which corridor the vehicle actually took between 20:03:10 and 20:05:50. Failing that, the deviation cannot be resolved in either direction and the fare stands as charged pending review.
